Would I come back? Probably not unless absolutely pressed.
Aug 2022 • Friends
Holup! それはおいしくないです.

Google has failed us! Choosing a sushi restaurant in a backpacker area is dangerous business!

Ordered a combo which had a fairly decent price but the wasabi presented was a disaster and a sad sight of the dryers wasabi I’ve ever seen (-1 point).

Biting into the nigiri, it was quite clear that the type of rice was not appropriate (not Japonica for example) and the vinegar content was almost undetectable (-1 point).

Soy sauce used is not appropriate for the subject matter (blacker than my heart on a bad day, -1 point).

Cuts of fish are also equally disappointing (-1 point).

In the defence of the restaurant, the maki (rolls) were decent and if I was only seeking this type of nourishment (i.e. wanted to fill my gullet with cheap fare), I might go here (+1 point).

Overall, calling this a top rated place is like calling McDonalds a top rated place.

Would I come back? Probably not unless absolutely pressed.
